Scope: sports grounds (padel, basketball and football), a service and toilet building, landscape works, bike and walking paths, and parking at three sites in Asir, Jazan and Jeddah.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours, over the WBS phases as in last week's report. The project is at 44.6% against 55.2% planned, 10.6% behind (SPI 0.81). It gained 2.2% this week against 4.2% planned, so the gap widened from 8.6% last week. Jazan is furthest behind at 30.4% against 49.4% planned; Jeddah is slightly ahead of its plan.

Project completion is now forecast 114 days late. The weekly report and the P6 update (data date 26-Oct-2026) both forecast completion on 19-May-2027, ten days later than last week and 114 days after the contract completion date of 25-Jan-2027. P6 shows −91 days of float on project completion and 320 open activities with negative float. The most critical path still runs through the air dome: on the most critical of the three domes, approval of the PVC membrane, steel tension cables, emergency doors and lock doors has not started and carries −91 days of float. The weekly report's own headline of 60.7% against 76.1% is not comparable with last week; see Data notes.

Work done this weekThe weekly summary lists the same ten items as last week: courts ground slab in Asir, air dome foundations and glazed-façade steelwork at all sites, irrigation pipes in Asir and Jeddah, curbs around the Jeddah courts, toilet ceramics and roof insulation, and lighting cables and pole foundations. Hardscape, trees, the air dome, irrigation pipe and lighting are still at 0 in this sheet, although this week's photos show irrigation pipe, planting beds and lighting pole bases being installed.

Data notes

  • The weekly report's headline physical progress jumped from 42.41% to 60.74% (plan 51.03% to 76.10%), with 18.33% "earned this week". The jump comes from a row that this week's total adds and last week's left out: P6's "No W-Construction" group, 84,775.4 planned and 65,538.7 earned man-hours. Its earned value was already 65,538.7 last week, and its 106,595.4-hour budget is not in the 406,255-hour denominator. This report therefore uses the WBS phases only, as last week: 44.6% against 55.2%.
  • The report week is the project week counted from site handover (26-Mar-2026 to 26-Oct-2026 is 214 days, week 30). The files carry the serial WPR-26 but state no week number.
  • This-week values compare this report with the 19-Oct-2026 report (week 29).
  • The weekly summary sheets (files 15 and 16), the Conclusion file (12) and the Tracking Progress file (10) label a cost-based progress figure as "actual". This report uses physical progress (man-hour weighted) only.
  • The list of works done this week (files 15 and 16) repeats last week's text almost word for word, and the Major Quantities sheet, invoices, safety statistics and risk register are unchanged from last week.
  • File 16 still names a different contractor (شركة الانجاز للتجارة والمقاولات), project manager (عبد الله الشنيفي), sector (القطاع الأوسط), start date 24-Nov-2025 and contract end 23-May-2026.
  • The supply summary in the Conclusion file changed its totals from last week (reinforcement 25 to 160 t, concrete 100 to 1,500, interlock 6,400 to 8,044 m², curbstone 17,550 to 8,900 LM) and gives curbstone as 1,900 delivered, against 2,000 of 8,868 LM in the Procurement Log tracker.
  • The quality statistics show 33 NCRs closed against 23 issued.
  • The Milestones sheet's baseline dates for programme approval (02-Jun-2026), mobilisation (25-Jan-2027) and testing and commissioning (29-Apr-2026) still look shifted, and the Conclusion file still dates project end as 25-Jan-2026.
  • The HSE statistics sheet still covers 06–13 Oct 2026 (137,270 cumulative man-hours, 159 toolbox talks), against 132,050 and 156 in the report summary. The invoice log still counts 47 consultant-approved invoices against 5 submitted.
  • File 08 is named for the 19-Oct-2026 report (WPR-25) and contains only a title page.
